1.title: What to Know About Cargo Plane That Overran Its Runway, Killing 5 in Miami
1.summary: The plane was operating as part of Amazon’s cargo fleet and had flown from Puerto Rico. It crashed into several vehicles after overrunning the runway.

2.title: How a Colorado School District Is Fighting Trump’s Anti-Transgender Push
2.summary: Jefferson County, Colo., is one of the few public school systems to sue the Trump administration over demands that it revoke transgender protections or face funding cuts.

3.title: Trump’s Trade War Is Shaping the Fight for Congress
3.summary: In Colorado and across the country, higher costs, tariffs and cheap beef imports are affecting voters who will help determine which party controls the House next year.

4.title: Burundians rush to leave Kenya ahead of crackdown on unregistered traders
4.summary: Kenya is due to start enforcing measures to restrict foreign nationals from operating small-scale businesses.

5.title: Israel Launches Deadly Strikes in Lebanon as Military Campaign Intensifies
5.summary: The bombardment killed nine people, Lebanese officials said, after days of attacks that have spurred worries that Israel is looking to push deeper into Lebanese territory.

6.title: After Victory in German State, Far Right Needs Help to Take Power
6.summary: The Alternative for Germany, or AfD, does not have a straightforward path to governing Saxony-Anhalt, but a small populist party could clear the way.
